hypothesis: Lowering outOfRangeWaitMinutes from main's 30 to 15 will improve net SOL per closed position by accelerating capital rotation on lower-OOR positions that would otherwise sit waiting for unlikely recoveries. Bid-ask post-ATH flow rarely benefits from waiting once price has cleared the lower bin.
kill_metric: winrate below 40% over 10 closed positions, OR no deploys in 5 days
sample_target: 10 closed positions OR 14 days, whichever first
expected_directional_outcome: Higher close frequency, shorter avg hold time, modest winrate improvement if recoveries are genuinely rare in this regime; risk: lose recoveries that would have come back to range
notes: Caps live in profiles/autoresearch/user-config.json. The only variable change vs main is outOfRangeWaitMinutes (15 vs 30); position sizing is smaller because the wallet is smaller, but the strategy mechanics are identical.
Direct PnL comparison must normalize for position size: use net_sol / deploy_sol per close, not raw PnL.
Compare with scripts/research-compare.js once sample size is met.
Telegram alerts arrive on the shared chat with [AUTORES] prefix.
